title: 通天河救童子
subtitle: 师徒替孩子完成送灯谜题
origin: 《西游记》第四十七至四十九回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 大人要主动保护孩子远离危险；遇到任性的要求，可以勇敢说不，再用智慧找出让每个人都安全的办法。
moral.en: Adults should keep children away from danger. We can say no to unsafe demands and use courage and wisdom to find a solution that protects everyone.

pages.zh: 师徒来到通天河边的陈家庄。陈关保和一秤金提着莲花灯，却不敢靠近水面：河里的水灵要求他们在夜里把灯送到河心。
pages.en: The travelers reached Chen Village beside the Tongtian River. Chen Guanbao and Yichengjin held lotus lanterns but stayed away from the water: a river spirit demanded that they deliver the lights to midstream at night.

pages.zh: 那位“灵感大王”其实是一只爱热闹的金鱼水灵。他把河面变成泡泡迷宫，还宣布：“只有把八盏灯送到正确位置，庆典才开始！”
pages.en: The River Inspiration Spirit was really a dramatic goldfish water spirit. He made a bubble maze and declared that the festival would begin only when eight lanterns reached the correct places.
pages.prompt: Create the first definitive River Inspiration Spirit anchor above a calm magical section of the Tongtian River. Character lock — The River Inspiration Spirit is a large friendly goldfish water spirit with a rounded coral-gold fish face, large teal eyes, soft fan-shaped fins beside his cheeks, and a flowing blue-green robe decorated with pearl bubbles; he wears one necklace of smooth white pearls and carries a glowing lotus lantern instead of a weapon; demanding and dramatic but never frightening, with no sharp teeth, claws, trident, armor, or attack pose; child-friendly rounded animated-film proportions. He floats upright on a broad cushion of blue bubbles just above the water, holding the glowing lotus lantern high like a festival host; eight empty circular pools in a harmless bubble maze shimmer around him, and gentle ribbon-like currents lead between them. pages.en: Children must not go onto dangerous water, Tang Monk said. The grown-ups will do this. Wukong and Bajie took the lanterns while the siblings stayed ashore and used colored flags to guide them.

pages.en: Sha Seng steadied a long rope from shore, Wukong laid his staff flat as a lantern rail, and Bajie arranged the lights in a circle. The river became a mirror, giving every lantern a bright reflection.

pages.en: At last, all eight lanterns reached their places. Guanyin came to the river and told the goldfish spirit that a festival should bring joy and must respect everyone's choice. The spirit apologized and agreed to learn from her.
